headline: Precision Wires India updates outcome of its board meeting
hook: Updated board outcome filed with the exchange
summary: Precision Wires India Limited has submitted an updated outcome of its board meeting held on November 6, 2026, to the stock exchange. Routine corporate filings of this nature do not typically disclose immediate financial details in the summary notice. Retail investors should check the exchange portal for the specific revised document.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no immediate impact on share price

headline: Precision Wires raises Rs 150 crore through convertible debentures and declares 35 percent dividend
hook: Strong revenue growth alongside a fresh dividend payout
summary: Precision Wires reported a 59 percent jump in Q2 revenue to Rs 1,950 crore. The company raised Rs 150 crore via convertible debentures to support operations. It also declared a 35 percent dividend for shareholders. Retail investors holding the stock benefit from both capital expansion plans and immediate cash payouts.
why_it_matters: Higher revenue and dividend payouts reward existing shareholders.

headline: Precision Wires India reports board meeting outcome
hook: Precision Wires board concludes scheduled meeting
summary: Precision Wires India Limited held a board meeting on November 06, 2026. The company formally notified the National Stock Exchange regarding the proceedings of this meeting. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no immediate impact on share price.
